data.title: 塑心 · 留给你的旋律
data.description: 她停下演奏，倾身问你最喜欢哪一段。听完回答，她笑着说，下一遍只演奏给你听。
data.action: 轻扶琴弓，倾身注视镜头
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Sitting with her cello in an intimate music salon, Virtuosa lowers her bow slightly and leans forward toward the viewer with an inviting, conspiratorial smile. An ornate brass music stand bearing handwritten scores and the rich glow of shaded floor lamps frame her poised figure.
data.animaCaption: Leaning forward with her bow resting lightly near the strings, she fixes the viewer with an amused, tender gaze, offering a private reprise of the melody.
